definitions.gloss: recitation from memory; reciting by heart
definitions.explanation: Speaking or performing a text, poem, or passage from memory without looking at the original. Common in educational settings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詩|し}→詩：02139_shi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{暗唱|あんしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To recite a poem from memory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{暗唱|あんしょう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I memorized and delivered the English speech.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えた→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦{百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}→百人一首：22329_hyakuninisshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{暗唱|あんしょう}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I can still recite from memory the Hundred Poems I learned as a child.

notes:
Also written as {暗誦|あんしょう} with the same meaning. The kanji {唱|しょう} means to chant or recite, while {暗|あん} means from memory (without looking).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{詩|し}→詩：02139_shi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{暗唱|あんしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to recite a poem by heart)
- {暗唱|あんしょう}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧ (recitation test)
- {暗唱|あんしょう}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (to be able to recite from memory)
- ⟦すらすら→すらすら：05363_surasura⟧{暗唱|あんしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to recite fluently from memory)

USAGE:
Common in Japanese schools, where students are sometimes asked to memorize and recite passages from textbooks, poems, or classical literature. Distinct from ⟦{朗読|ろうどく}→朗読：14875_roudoku⟧ (reading aloud), which involves reading from a text.
